Local qualifying results at the tested source:

- Backend PostgreSQL suite: **547 PASS, 2 SKIP, 0 FAIL/ERROR** (549 total). The two local pinned-binary cases remain NOT TESTED: `test_actual_contrib_accepts_five_methods` and `test_actual_scrape_and_log_rotation_truncation_restart`. The CI job results above are reported separately, not substituted for local execution.
- Frontend: **38 PASS**; lint and production build PASS.
- Full existing HTTP/browser harness: **13 grouped gates PASS**, **67 focused HTTP assertions PASS**, **17 Chromium assertion groups PASS**, plus existing CRUD and pagination probes.
- Final collector UI correction removes retained legacy source/collector identities from operational rows and creation selectors. Browser positive control requires a visible supported collector. Failed fixture attempts 9–12 are preserved, including the missing explicit customer-selection diagnosis; no empty-table result was accepted as proof.
- Nested/aliased and persisted-configuration bypasses fenced at input, templates, activation, worker scheduling and execution boundaries; retired association mutations denied, tenant/RBAC and supported journeys retained.
- Fresh migration, populated upgrade, backup/restore and content-hash preservation PASS: **100 tables, 1,116 rows, 499 constraints**. Legacy history and applied migrations retained; no destructive retirement.
- Owned final Docker containers/networks and application processes cleaned up; failed-run private synthetic credentials removed after redacted evidence retention. No broad Docker cleanup. Older pre-fix anonymous-volume attribution remains a disclosed limitation.

Evidence: [acceptance matrix](https://github.com/Parikshit-Sahrawat/OpsControl_Dashboard/tree/ec9c712a22db9bc46e101edafcc2f5e09b165025/docs/verification/scope-removal/kubernetes-platforms/FINAL_ACCEPTANCE_MATRIX.md), [dated raw logs/screenshots/source identities](https://github.com/Parikshit-Sahrawat/OpsControl_Dashboard/tree/ec9c712a22db9bc46e101edafcc2f5e09b165025/docs/verification/scope-removal/kubernetes-platforms/close-2026-10-29), [failed attempts](https://github.com/Parikshit-Sahrawat/OpsControl_Dashboard/tree/ec9c712a22db9bc46e101edafcc2f5e09b165025/docs/verification/scope-removal/kubernetes-platforms/close-attempts), [risks](https://github.com/Parikshit-Sahrawat/OpsControl_Dashboard/tree/ec9c712a22db9bc46e101edafcc2f5e09b165025/docs/verification/scope-removal/kubernetes-platforms/OPEN_RISKS.md).
SHA-256 manifest: [ARTIFACT_SHA256.json](https://github.com/Parikshit-Sahrawat/OpsControl_Dashboard/tree/ec9c712a22db9bc46e101edafcc2f5e09b165025/docs/verification/scope-removal/kubernetes-platforms/ARTIFACT_SHA256.json), **408 artifacts**; manifest SHA-256 `47a719b8f188ce55761af83c5aee0dc1247b64c5d587ac1f0e8a3d0c0f01f640`.

All four scoped removal workstreams are ready for independent owner acceptance review, not automatically accepted. Synthetic fixtures do not certify genuine providers or owner UAT. Physical in-flight worker draining, fleet-scale scheduler performance, historical orphan-volume attribution and the pre-existing auxiliary EKS ledger serialization defect remain disclosed. Future schema retirement requires separate data-owner/export/retention/recovery authorization.

**CHK-001 FAIL · CHK-002 BLOCKED · SECURITY BLOCKED · RELEASE NO-GO.** Production collector pin unchanged. No production/UAT access, merge, deployment, risk waiver or gate promotion.
